continuous_interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of trial means; seed 6216
paired_difference_interval: Conservative 95% difference bound from Bonferroni-adjusted exact binomial marginal intervals; paired discordances and exact McNemar p also reported
failure_selection: First failed seed per method, none before disturbance; paired full-method trial included regardless of outcome. Main video is the lowest successful full-method seed without disturbance. Original trajectories only; no rerun footage.
interpretation: Fresh rack-only evaluation after motion revision, separate from evaluation-v1. Seeds 100-109 informed development; 200-209 are reserved for this evaluation. Both methods receive identical motion fixes. No guarantee the full method wins. Ten trials give wide uncertainty.
